# Teams

Manage teams in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::teams()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\General\Teams` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `teams.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of team UUIDs to filter by |
| `team_lead_id` | Filter teams by team leader user ID |
| `term` | Filter by team name |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | Team name |

## Examples

Get all teams:

```php
$teams = Teamleader::teams()->list();
```

Search teams by name:

```php
$teams = Teamleader::teams()->list(['term' => 'Designers']);
```

Get teams by team leader:

```php
$teams = Teamleader::teams()->list(['team_lead_id' => 'user-uuid']);
```

Get teams sorted by name:

```php
$teams = Teamleader::teams()->list([], ['sort' => [['field' => 'name', 'order' => 'asc']]]);
```

Get specific teams by ID:

```php
$teams = Teamleader::teams()->list(['ids' => ['team-uuid-1', 'team-uuid-2']]);
```
